title: 第三章 击杀高级变异体
slug: 重生末日最强生存系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

随着低吼声越来越近，林夕逐渐看清了正在狂奔而来的高级变异体。

王晨开口说道：“各位，不想死就使出全力吧。”

赵龙冷哼一声没有说话，林夕说道：”自然如此。“

说罢，赵龙王晨均是拿出自己的武器，林夕看了一眼，随后便将戒指中刚才收进去的长刀拿了出来，握在了手上。

王晨说道：”林兄还会用刀？“

林夕笑了笑说道：”用剑者，自会用刀，注意，它来了。“

话音刚落一个高壮的身影便出现在三人眼前。

随之林夕这边也有一人冲了出去，赵龙手持双刀一马当先。

林夕紧随其后，而在身后的王晨则是充当起了辅助的责任。

在林夕的记忆中四大世家，分别代表四种元素，火，土，风，水。

而王家便是称为最强防御的土，赵家则是最强攻击水。

刚开始的时候四大家互不相让还在争夺四家之首

到后期，逐渐成长的丧尸以及变异体，让四大世家渐渐融合，最后建立了救赎根据地。

王晨一挥手，两道暗金色的盾牌便出现在两人身上。

与此同时，林夕也逐渐的凝聚出冰铠

刹那间两人一尸便撞在了一起。

赵龙双刀齐砍，变异体伸出手臂阻挡

当的一声，赵龙只感觉虎口一麻，双刀险些脱手。

变异体右臂阻挡之后，左手向赵龙挠来

林夕急忙上前一刀砍向变异体，虽然挡住了赵龙的双刀，但是它本身也不太好受，所有才会用左手攻击，看到林夕向自己砍来，只得挥手抵挡

不出所料地是，林夕也被一掌击退。

相同退后的两人，对视一眼，林夕说道：”腰，脖子。“

赵龙开口说道：“脖子。”

林夕点了点头冲着身后的王晨说道：“想办法控住它。”

说罢便又一次和赵龙一起冲向变异体。

Page (1/3)

As the roar got closer and closer, Lin Xi gradually saw the advanced mutant running towards him.

Wang Chen said: "Everyone, if you don't want to die, just use all your strength."

Zhao Long snorted and said nothing. Lin Xi said, "Of course it is."

After saying that, Zhao Long and Wang Chenjun took out their weapons. Lin Xi took a look at it, then took out the long knife that had just been put in the ring and held it in his hand.

Wang Chen said: "Brother Lin can also use a knife?"

Lin Xi smiled and said: "Those who use swords will know how to use them. Pay attention, it is coming."

As soon as he finished speaking, a tall and sturdy figure appeared in front of the three of them.

Then someone from Lin Xi's side rushed out, and Zhao Long took the lead with two swords in hand.

Lin Xi followed closely behind, while Wang Chen behind him acted as an assistant.

In Lin Xi's memory, the four major families represent the four elements, fire, earth, wind, and water.

The Wang family is called the earth with the strongest defense, and the Zhao family is the water with the strongest attack.

At the beginning, the four families refused to give in to each other and were still competing for the top spot among the four families.

In the later stage, the gradually growing zombies and mutants gradually merged the four major families, and finally established a redemption base.

Wang Chen waved his hand, and two dark golden shields appeared on the two of them.

At the same time, Lin Xi also gradually condensed the ice armor.

In an instant, the two bodies collided with each other.

Zhao Long slashed with both swords, and the mutant stretched out his arm to block it.

With a bang, Zhao Long felt his mouth go numb and almost lost his sword.

After the mutant blocked it with his right arm, he scratched Zhao Long with his left hand.

Lin Xi hurriedly stepped forward and slashed at the mutant. Although it blocked Zhao Long's double swords, it itself was not very comfortable, so it only used its left hand to attack. Seeing Lin Xi slashing towards her, she had to wave to block it.

As expected, Lin Xi was also knocked back by a palm.

The two people who also stepped back looked at each other, and Lin Xi said: "Waist, neck."

Zhao Long said: "Neck."

Lin Xi nodded and said to Wang Chen behind him: "Find a way to control it."

After saying that, he and Zhao Long rushed towards the mutant again.
